message: 天使の溜息
And so, we immediately gathered after school and started singing practice, but......

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, let the karaoke tournament begin!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yay, Nana-chan's the best」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, Azel-san, let's sing together too!」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I...... am rather poor at karaoke, you see......」

name: Paqy
message: 「This ain't anything like karaoke, ya know」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder how things ended up like this......」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, as long as everyone's having fun, it's fine, isn't it\s02」
Part of the reason I invited everyone was because it'd be fun, sure, but I actually had a little ulterior motive.

name: Amyrina
message: 「Everyone sure loves singing songs, don't you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stress relief!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Calorie burning!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's go in order」
For some reason, we ended up pairing off into duets.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sweets!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sweets!」

name: Misa
message: 「Azel-san. Let's do our best」

name: Azel
message: 「Why must I do something like this......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai-san! Let's get this crowd pumped up!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah! Let's do our best♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama. Don't you dare drag yours truly down, got it?」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Got it!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Um, as for me......」

name: Shio
message: 「Urgh...... Lady Amyrina...... You are paired with me, milady」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Naginata-san! Please, I'd love for you to join us!」

name: Shio
message: 「Yet how pathetic I am...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「What's the matter?」

name: Shio
message: 「Truth be told, I am scarcely acquainted with the popular songs of the secular world.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That's true for me as well, you know...?」

name: Shio
message: 「That is not all. To raise my voice before so many esteemed souls... Perish the thought!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「According to the guidebook, shrine maidens often sing and dance at shrine festivals, though...」

name: Misa
message: 「Come to think of it, Shion only ever dances.」

name: Shio
message: 「G-Gah!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Naginata-san...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's okay! We're all embarrassed together. Besides...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Giving up on something this fun just because it's embarrassing would be such a waste.」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Amyrina...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「If you'll sing with me, Naginata-san, I'll do my best too! So...」

name: Shio
message: 「Mmm... Were I to fail to steel my resolve after this, it would be a disgrace to the name of a warrior. To see what is right and not do it is a lack of courage--truly, these words apply here.」

name: Shio
message: 「Even if it be painful to the ears, I shall charge forth prepared for glorious defeat!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nobody said it's going to be painful to listen to yet\s02」
And so we took turns singing, while those listening cheered each other on.
It wasn't quite a karaoke box, yet everyone was having a wonderful time.

name: Shio
message: 「Hah... How exhilarating and delightful!」

name: Shio
message: 「Truly, 'Learning without thought is labor lost, and thought without learning is perilous'--this is the very essence of it!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「See, Naginata-san? You sang wonderfully!」

name: Shio
message: 「Ah, well... I am deeply apologetic that I could only offer children's songs and the like...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Not at all. Every single one was a lovely song. As long as you can have fun singing it, I think any song is wonderful.」

name: Shio
message: 「I see... Whether one is out of touch with the modern world or not makes no difference, then.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That's right. So there's no need to be embarrassed」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though you're saying that, Amyrina, you were super shy yourself right up until we got here today~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「L-Lolotte!\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, now that we're done warming up... shall we start practicing the Christmas songs?」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeaaah!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it okay if we don't call Riesling?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes. It would be a shame to wake her up right away」
Well, I get the feeling she's probably waiting around nearby even without being called.
Even after everyone else went home, Lolotte alone is fast asleep, and it seems Amyrina is staying behind to match her.

name: Synn
message: 「How was today?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It was so much fun... ♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Even Shio, who was holding back so much at first, seems to have completely fallen in love with singing」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes, I'm truly glad」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... and you too, Amyrina」

name: Synn
message: 「Today... you sang a lot in front of everyone」

name: Synn
message: 「In front of people other than just me and Misa, you know」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I-I did... Ahhh, now that I realize it...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「It looks like the joy of singing has grown bigger than worrying about feeling embarrassed」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Uu... When you point it out, I start getting embarrassed...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha. Well, there's no need to rush, just take your time getting used to it」

name: Amyrina
message: 「President... did you set up today just for that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Only a little bit. Honestly, I mostly just wanted to hang out and have a lively time with everyone」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Is that so... Thank you very much!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, like I was saying--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I heard from Lolotte that at times like this, you always try to hide your embarrassment, President.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... She's got you figured out」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez. I'm hungry~~」

name: Synn
message: 「O-oh, welcome back」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll help out, so hurry up and make dinner~」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, alright. How about we have curry and rice today, then?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Curry!?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Giggle... Oh, Lolotte」

name: Paqy
message: 「By the way, it's curry \{again|\s12} today...」
